clips.title: 美方前能源官员提议柴油出口与库存挂钩
title_lines: 美方前能源官员霍克斯坦
提议柴油出口与库存挂钩
不再二元禁令 按库存调节出口量

subtitles.en: Diesel export ban, you studied it too.
subtitles.zh: 柴油出口禁令，你也研究过。

subtitles.en: Look, in 2022, I looked at a product.
What do we do about it? We were at $5 a gallon and gasoline in June of 2022.
subtitles.zh: 我们该怎么办？2022年6月，汽油价格达到每加仑5美元。

subtitles.en: I don't believe that we have to look at this just as a ban or no ban.
subtitles.zh: 我不认为我们必须只从禁或不禁的角度来看待这个问题。

subtitles.en: There's clearly a problem when we are exporting significant amounts and we are getting to points that could be price points in the United States.
subtitles.zh: 当我们大量出口，并且达到可能影响美国价格的水平时，显然存在问题。

subtitles.en: It could be damaging to the economy and lead you eventually down to a recession.
subtitles.zh: 这可能对经济造成损害，并最终导致经济下行。

subtitles.en: So you can't just say, oh, we can't do anything about it because there's some purity test of we don't export.
subtitles.zh: 所以你不能说，哦，我们无能为力，因为有不出口的纯洁性测试。

subtitles.en: And by the way, for decades, we didn't export any crude and I negotiated the deal with Senator Morkowski at the time in 2015 or 2016 to allow exports.
subtitles.zh: 顺便说一句，几十年来，我们没有出口任何原油，我在2015年或2016年与时任参议员穆尔科斯基谈判达成了允许出口的协议。

subtitles.en: So it's not like this thing that we've always done exports.
subtitles.zh: 所以并不是我们一直在做出口这件事。

subtitles.en: I think that we have to look at a policy that ties our exports levels to inventories.
subtitles.zh: 我认为我们必须考虑一种将出口水平与库存挂钩的政策。
en_highlights: ties our exports levels to inventories

subtitles.en: And so when we have commercial inventories and government inventories of diesel and gasoline at a certain level, you are free to export as much as you want.
subtitles.zh: 当商业库存和政府库存的柴油和汽油处于一定水平时，你可以自由出口任意数量。

subtitles.en: When they get reduced by a certain amount, exports get reduced by a certain amount.
subtitles.zh: 当它们减少一定量时，出口也相应减少一定量。

subtitles.en: It doesn't have to be a ban or no ban. We can actually limit volume of exports.
subtitles.zh: 不一定是禁止或不禁止。我们实际上可以限制出口量。

subtitles.en: We can restrict it to no increases in exports, et cetera.
subtitles.zh: 我们可以限制出口不增加等等。

subtitles.en: There are things that levers that we can do and I think that we got into the wrong place of discussing this as a totally binary ban or no ban.
subtitles.zh: 我们可以采取一些杠杆措施，我认为我们陷入了错误的方向，将其讨论为完全二元禁止或不禁止。

clip_research.source_claim: Hochstein proposes tying US diesel export levels to domestic inventories instead of an outright export ban, citing 2022 conditions when gasoline hit $5/gallon and distillate inventories were low.
clip_research.public_baseline: In 2022 US distillate inventories fell to the lowest October level since 1951 and national average gasoline hit $5.01/gal in June 2022; the 40-year crude oil export ban was repealed in late 2015 via a bipartisan deal in which Sen. Lisa Murkowski was a leading force.
clip_research.surprise_gap: A former senior US energy official publicly floats a managed-export mechanism rather than a simple ban, acknowledging that unrestricted exports can push domestic prices toward recessionary levels — a notable admission from an insider who previously helped liberalize crude exports.

evidence.fact: Hochstein: 'I think that we have to look at a policy that ties our exports levels to inventories.'
Hochstein: 'We were at $5 a gallon and gasoline in June of 2022.'
Hochstein: 'for decades, we didn't export any crude and I negotiated the deal with Senator Morkowski at the time in 2015 or 2016 to allow exports.'

winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架

让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突

经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
